copy.title: Keep a copy on this device
copies.heading: Saved from nearby devices
copies.help: Open or remove copies saved from another Tonalli device. Unlock Admin to remove a copy. Originals and copies on other devices stay unchanged.
copies.loadFailed: Could not load saved copies. Your content is unchanged. Try refreshing.
copies.confirm: Remove {title} from this device? The sharing device's original will stay unchanged.
copies.locked: Unlock Admin again to remove this copy.
copies.inUse: This copy is in use. Close its readers and stop sharing it, then try again.
copies.removeFailed: Removal could not finish. Refresh and try again. Other content is unchanged.
copies.cleanupPending: Removal incomplete. Finish removal to free the remaining space.
copy.help: Save the selected book for offline reading. Keep the devices on the same local network and the other device sharing. Your existing library stays on this device.
copy.withSearch: Also copy article search, so searching inside articles works offline when the other device has prepared it.
copy.searchUnavailable: The other device has not prepared article search. The book was saved; you can prepare search on this device.
copy.searchFailed: The book was saved, but article search could not be copied. You can prepare it on this device.
copy.searchCancelled: The book was saved. Article search was not copied.
copy.mapHelp: Save the selected map for offline use. Keep the devices on the same local network and the other device sharing. Your existing maps stay on this device.
copy.finishCurrent: Finish or cancel this copy before starting another.
copy.progressHelp: Your nearby-library copy stays separate from catalog downloads. Completed copies open from your local Library or Maps.
copy.backgroundHelp: You can leave this screen while copying. Keep Wi-Fi connected and the other device sharing. The notification lets you pause.
copy.foregroundHelp: Keep Tonalli open and the other device sharing on the same local network until copying finishes.
copy.reconnectHelp: Reconnect to the nearby library, then return to its book or map to resume this copy.
content.error.copy_failed: Could not save the copy. Check that the sharing device is still available, then retry. Your existing library is unchanged.
notes.heading: Encrypted notes
notes.initialize: Your notes are encrypted on this device. Unlock an existing vault or create one below.
notes.error.lock_unconfirmed: Notes are cleared here, but server lock is unconfirmed. Retry or close the shared UI.
notes.title: Title
notes.error.notes_locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue.
notes.error.unlock_failed: The passphrase or recovery key was not accepted.
notes.error.notes_not_initialized: No notes vault yet. Choose Create encrypted notes to get started.
notes.error.recovery_required: Use the recovery key to open this vault.
notes.error.invalid_request: The request was not accepted. Check the input.
notes.error.input_too_large: This text is too long. Try a shorter entry.
notes.error.invalid_response: The local vault returned an invalid response.
notes.error.notes_unavailable: The local vault is unavailable. If a lock request failed, server lock is unconfirmed; retry or close the shared UI.
app.choose: Choose a library, article, map, or encrypted notes.
app.failed: Content could not be opened. Close and reopen the app, then try again.
library.heading: Library
library.bodyHint: Find words inside articles in this library.
library.bodyIndexMissing: Searching inside articles is not available for this content yet. Choose Titles to keep searching and reading.
library.bodyMediaRemoved: The library's storage is unavailable. Reconnect it and reopen the library before searching again.
library.bodyFailed: Search could not finish. Try another search, or choose Titles.
article.choose: Choose an article from the library.
map.heading: Offline map
chat.independent: Completed replies are used as context. Stopped or failed replies are excluded. Start a new conversation to change books.
chat.noRetrieval: General chat does not retrieve library sources or verify answer support.
chat.truncated: This answer reached the output limit and was cut off. Continue is unavailable in this independent-question checkpoint.
chat.question: Question
chat.placeholder: Ask {name} a question… (Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.stopRequested: Stop requested. Partial output is retained.
chat.stopUnconfirmed: Native stop could not be confirmed. Do not assume the model has stopped.
chat.unavailable: AI is off or unavailable. Choose a downloaded model in Settings to begin.
chat.session: The local session changed. Reopen this screen.
library.openContent: Get content to download something to read, or choose Open a file to use a file you already have.
library.searchFailed: Title search is unavailable. Try again.
library.prefixHint: Start with the first words of a title. Capital letters matter.
content.heading: Get content
content.openLocal: Choose something to read offline. For files you already have, choose Open a file.
content.downloadsUnavailable: The catalog is available. Downloads are not enabled in this session.
content.catalogEmpty: No content is available right now. Try again later.
content.cancelConfirm: Cancel this download? Unfinished data will be removed after it stops.
content.error.failed: The content request could not be completed. Refresh to check its current state.
content.error.invalid_request: This content request was not accepted.
content.error.invalid_response: Content information could not be loaded. Choose Refresh to try again.
content.error.session: Close and reopen the app, then try again.
content.error.request_unconfirmed: The request may have been accepted. Refresh to check before retrying.
content.error.content_unavailable: Content management is unavailable. Your existing library remains available.
content.error.download_unavailable: Downloads are not enabled in this session.
content.error.catalog_changed: The catalog changed. Refresh and select the content again.
content.error.busy: A download action is still in progress. Wait for it to finish.
content.error.not_found: This content or download is no longer available. Refresh the list.
content.error.in_use: This content is in use. Close its readers and try again.
content.error.no_space: There is not enough available space for this action.
content.error.waiting_wifi: A Wi-Fi connection is required for this download.
content.error.unsupported_kind: This content type cannot be installed yet.
content.error.incomplete_bundle: This map is missing its complete offline assets and cannot be installed.
content.error.source_unavailable: The content source is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
content.error.publication_uncertain: Content may have changed. The save could not be confirmed; refresh before retrying.
content.error.checkpoint_failed: Download progress could not be saved. Refresh before resuming.
content.error.io_error: The storage operation failed. Check storage availability before retrying.
content.error.checksum: The download could not be checked. Try downloading it again.
content.error.network_error: The download connection failed. Refresh to check whether it can resume.
content.error.invalid_content: The content did not pass verification. Your installed version was preserved.
content.error.network: The download connection failed. Refresh before retrying.
content.error.media_removed: The storage source was removed. Reconnect it before retrying.
content.error.io: The storage operation failed. Check storage availability before retrying.
content.error.dispatch_rejected: The background task could not start. Retry or cancel this download.
library.prepare.title: Prepare article search
library.prepare.hint: You can keep reading and searching titles. On your phone, connect a charger to prepare article search.
library.prepare.readyHint: You can now search inside this book's articles.
library.prepare.error.failed: Preparation could not finish. Try again, or keep using Titles.
library.prepare.error.no_space: Free some storage, then resume preparation. Titles and reading are still available.
library.prepare.error.media_removed: Reconnect this book's storage before resuming preparation.
library.prepare.error.source_unavailable: Reopen this book before resuming preparation.
library.prepare.error.stale_source: Cancel the previous preparation, then prepare search for the current book.
library.prepare.error.publication_uncert: Preparation could not be confirmed. Reopen the book to check its search before trying again.
library.prepare.error.busy: Another book is being prepared. Pause or finish it before preparing this one.
library.prepare.error.session: Reopen the app, then try again.
library.prepare.error.request_unconfirme: Your request could not be confirmed. Check the current preparation status before trying again.
library.subtitle: Your books and articles, ready offline.
settings.deviceLanguage: Tonalli follows your device language: English or Spanish.
settings.private: Your library and encrypted notes stay on this device. Sharing is off unless you turn it on.
settings.advancedHelp: Technical import and diagnostic tools. Everyday downloads, maps, notes and sharing are above. Android opens its device tools; Windows opens the configured disc-image importer.
notifications.title: Notifications are off
notifications.help: Downloads, nearby copies, music and sharing keep running in the background. Turn notifications on to see their progress and Stop or Pause buttons.
update.title: App updates
update.help: Find out when a newer version of Tonalli is available, then download and install it from here. Your library, notes and settings stay as they are.
update.privacy: Off by default. Tonalli only contacts the update address you enter below, and only after you turn this on. Updates are accepted only if they are signed with the key you trust.
update.source: Update address (GitHub owner/repo or an https address)
update.keyHelp: Get the address and the key from whoever publishes your copy of Tonalli. Without the right key, no update is accepted.
update.noPackage: A newer version exists, but not for this device.
update.applyHelp: The update is downloaded and verified. Tonalli will close, replace its files and open again.
update.installHelp: The update is downloaded and verified. Android will ask you to confirm the installation.
update.iphoneHelp: iPhone apps cannot update themselves. Download the new file from this page in your browser and install it the same way as before (Sideloadly or AltStore).
update.unsupported: This device cannot update Tonalli by itself.
update.off: Turn on update checks and save first.
update.invalidSettings: That address or key is not valid. Use owner/repo or an https address, and a 64-character key.
update.error.update_signature: The update was not signed with your trusted key, so it was ignored.
update.error.update_unreachable: Could not reach the update address. Check your connection and try again.
update.error.update_no_space: There is not enough free storage for the update.
update.error.update_invalid: The update information was not valid, so it was ignored.
settings.aboutText: Free offline knowledge. Built with open source software, including adapted Project NOMAD components.
notes.recoveryHelp: Save this recovery key somewhere safe, outside this device. It can unlock your notes if you forget your passphrase. It is shown only once.
notes.setupHelp: Choose a passphrase for your private notes. Keep your recovery key safe. Existing notes will never be replaced.
notes.error.vault_exists: A notes vault already exists. Unlock it above; your notes were preserved.
notes.recoveryPrivate: Keep your recovery key outside this device. Anyone with it can unlock your notes.
notes.passphraseChanged: Passphrase changed. Your notes and recovery key are unchanged.
notes.error.rotation_uncertain: The passphrase change could not be confirmed. Try unlocking with the new passphrase or your recovery key.
map.locationReady: Your location is shown only on this map.
map.locationDenied: Location permission was not granted. You can still browse your downloaded maps.
map.locationUnavailable: Your location is unavailable. Check device location settings, or keep browsing the map.
map.downloadHelp: Choose a country and detail level, then check its download size. Downloads use Wi-Fi. Installed maps stay available while an update downloads.
map.error.no_space: There is not enough free storage. Free some space and try again.
map.error.checksum: Saved download data did not pass verification. Check the download size again to start a fresh download.
map.error.network: The connection was interrupted. Resume on Wi-Fi, or check the size again if the source is no longer available.
map.error.map_unavailable: This map could not be prepared. Try a smaller detail level or check the download again. Your installed map was preserved.
map.error.failed: The map request could not be confirmed. Check the current status before trying again.
map.importHelp: Import a PMTiles map file you already have. A verified copy is stored in the app; coverage depends on the file. Your original stays unchanged.
settings.contentHelp: Download books and maps, manage saved copies, or open a file from your device.
settings.notesHelp: Open Notes to lock or unlock your vault. Recovery keys and passphrase changes are under Protection after unlocking.
sharing.title: Share your library
sharing.fallbackHelp: Some browsers or networks cannot resolve local names. Try this IP link on the same Wi-Fi instead. Verify the certificate before pairing. A new sharing session may require certificate verification again.
sharing.help: Let paired nearby devices read your whole library and join LAN chat. Notes, settings and reading history always stay private. Untick anything you do not want to share. Sharing is off when the app opens.
sharing.choose: Books and maps in your library
sharing.empty: There are no installed books or maps to share. You can start LAN chat without content.
sharing.noNetwork: Connect to a private Wi-Fi or wired network, then try again.
sharing.hotspotHelp: Your phone creates a temporary Wi-Fi network for nearby devices. Some phones disconnect from their own Wi-Fi while it is on. It turns off when you stop sharing.
sharing.hotspotPermissionHelp: Android needs your permission to create a temporary Wi-Fi network for sharing.
sharing.hotspotJoin: First, join this temporary Wi-Fi network from the other device.
sharing.iosHotspotOff: No router or Wi-Fi? Use this iPhone's Personal Hotspot. iOS only lets you switch it on yourself: open Settings, tap Personal Hotspot, then turn on Allow Others to Join. Come back here and Tonalli will notice it on its own.
sharing.iosHotspotWait: Not showing up? On some iPhones the hotspot appears here only after another device has joined it. Join it from the other device, then come back.
sharing.iosHotspotReady: Personal Hotspot is on. Choose it under Local network, then press Start sharing. The other device joins the hotspot with the name and password shown in Settings > Personal Hotspot (Tonalli cannot read them), then opens the address Tonalli shows.
sharing.iosHotspotJoin: First join this iPhone's Personal Hotspot from the other device, using the name and password shown in Settings > Personal Hotspot. Then open the address below.
sharing.connect: On the other device, join the same local network and open this link in a browser. Enter the pairing code when asked.
sharing.certificateHelp: When a browser needs certificate verification, compare its certificate SHA-256 fingerprint with this value on the hosting device. Continue only if they match. Do not install a system-wide trusted certificate.
sharing.trust: This app uses its own private certificate. A browser may ask you to verify it before showing the pairing page. Verify the host with its owner before continuing; the pairing code alone does not authenticate the certificate. Do not enter the code if you cannot verify the host.
sharing.lifetime: Keep Tonalli open while sharing. Stop sharing here or quit the app to disconnect everyone. Android can also stop sharing from its notification, on low battery, or when Wi-Fi is lost.
sharing.error: Sharing could not be confirmed. Check your local network and app permissions. A local-name conflict stops sharing; stop any duplicate host and try again.
admin.heading: Local Admin
admin.help: Protect changes to this app. Ordinary reading does not require an Admin password.
admin.loginHelp: Enter your local Admin password to change these settings.
admin.setupHelp: Create a password of at least 12 characters. Keep it safe: there is no password reset. This password is separate from Notes.
admin.menuHelp: Hiding a page changes the menu only. Your maps and notes are kept. Library and Settings always remain available.
admin.session: Admin locks when you leave this page, restart the app, or after 15 minutes.
admin.error.wrong: Incorrect Admin password. Your settings have not changed.
admin.error.wait: Please wait a moment before trying again.
admin.error.changed: These settings changed. Lock and unlock Admin to reload them.
admin.error.unavailable: Admin is unavailable. Your existing settings are kept. Try reopening the app.
files.heading: Files
files.help: Manage ordinary copies on this device. Originals stay where they are. These files are separate from encrypted Notes; keep private notes in Notes. Files are not shared until you start sharing in Settings. Then they are shared with your library unless you untick them.
files.copyHelp: Choose up to 100 files. Each is copied and checked before it appears below. Keep the app open while importing.
files.empty: No files here yet. Unlock Admin above to add managed copies.
files.textLimit: Plain UTF-8 text only, up to 64 KiB. Changes replace the managed copy; the original stays unchanged.
files.deleteHelp: This removes the copy from this app. The original file is kept.
files.error.invalid_file: Choose a shorter ordinary file name or folder. Text editing supports small UTF-8 text files only.
files.error.file_changed: This file changed. Refresh files before editing or deleting it.
files.error.file_missing: This managed file is no longer available. Refresh files.
files.error.storage_full: Not enough free storage. Existing files were kept.
files.error.file_damaged: The file is incomplete or damaged. Existing managed copies were kept.
files.error.file_state_uncertain: The library may have changed, but the operation could not finish completely. Refresh files before retrying.
files.error.files_unavailable: Files are unavailable. Check free storage and reopen the app; existing data is kept.
files.error.admin_locked: Admin is locked. Unlock it before changing files.
files.nativeHelp: Choose files or a folder with the Android picker. Imports use read-only access and keep originals. The one-use approval lasts 15 minutes and can finish if Android closes the reader.
files.error.import_stopped: Import stopped. Completed copies are kept.
unified.heading: Your whole library
unified.help: Browse managed files by category, or search file names, folders and article titles across installed books. Open a book below for its full reading and search tools.
unified.failed: Some library content could not be loaded. Your files are kept. Try reopening Library.
unified.empty: Your library is empty. Get content or add files to begin.
reading.heading: Continue reading and bookmarks
reading.failed: Reading progress could not be saved or loaded. Your content is still available.
reading.empty: Open something to keep your place here.
reading.unavailable: Content unavailable. Add it again or open another item.
music.failed: Music could not complete that action. Check the file and try again; refresh if the queue changed.
music.help: Play your imported music offline. Your queue and position are saved. Playback starts when you choose Play.
music.empty: No music yet. Import audio files or a folder in Files.
music.queueEmpty: Choose a track or a playlist to get started.
music.name: Playlist name
music.deleteConfirm: Delete this playlist and remove it from other playlists? Your files and current queue will be kept.
video.help: Watch your imported videos offline. Your playback position is saved privately.
video.empty: No matching videos. Import a movie or show folder in Files to get started.
video.coversHelp: For covers, import poster.jpg, cover.png or an image with the same name beside the video. Season and Specials folders group episodes.
video.failed: This video is unavailable. Reopen it or import another copy in Files.
video.missing: This video is no longer in your managed library. Choose another video or import a copy in Files.
video.unsupported: This file could not be played here. Try another copy or an MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio. Your original file is kept.
video.saveFailed: Your saved playback position is unavailable or could not be saved. Playback can continue; check free storage and try again.
gallery.help: Browse imported photos and videos offline. Select an image to open it; videos open in Movies & shows.
gallery.import: Import photos or videos in Files
gallery.unsupported: This image could not be opened here. You can still save a copy from its file page. Your original is kept.
gallery.failed: Your gallery could not be loaded. Try opening it again.
gallery.missing: This file is no longer available here.
gallery.file: File details and save a copy
gallery.empty: No matching photos or videos. Import some in Files to get started.
file.heading: File details
file.help: Open imported files or save a copy. Your originals are kept.
shared.help: Only files this Tonalli host is sharing appear here. You can read or save a copy while sharing is on. Changes, Notes and private history are unavailable.
shared.empty: No files have been shared, or none match your search. Ask the host to start sharing, and check they have not removed the file from sharing.
shared.downloadHelp: Save a copy to open this file in a compatible app.
sharing.mediaHelp: All imported files are shared, read-only, with paired devices. Untick a file to keep it private.
sharing.removeHelp: Remove an item to stop sharing it right away. To share it again, stop sharing and start again.
sharing.nothingShared: Nothing from your library is shared. Paired devices can still use chat.
sharing.tooMany: Your library has more than 1024 imported files. Untick some of them to start sharing.
sharing.noFiles: Import files in Files to share photos, videos, music or documents.
sharing.snapshotHelp: Files are shared as copies taken when sharing started. Stop and start sharing again to include later edits. On the paired device, open Shared files.
article.documentLimit: Documents opened from a pack can be up to 64 MB. Import a larger original file in Files.
article.copyHelp: Keep a copy in Library to open or save to another folder. The installed pack stays unchanged.
article.copied: A copy is ready in Library.
article.copyFailed: This copy could not be saved. Check available storage and unlock Admin, then try again.
book.failed: This book could not be opened. Try an EPUB or CBZ without password protection. Your original file is kept.
book.imageFailed: This page could not be shown. It may be damaged or use an unsupported image format.
document.import: Import books or comics in Files
document.help: Open imported books and comics. Your reading position stays on this device.
document.empty: Import a book or comic in Files to begin reading.
document.failed: This document could not be opened. It may be damaged, password-protected or unsupported. PDFs must be smaller than 512 MB. Your original file is kept.
recipe.help: Your recipes, ready offline. Import a .cook file or add your own.
recipe.empty: No recipes yet. Import a recipe or add one to get started.
recipe.private: Ingredient and step ticks stay on this device. Editing a recipe starts a new checklist.
recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.editorHelp: Write each step as a paragraph. Mark ingredients like @rice{2%cup}. Up to 64 KB, 128 ingredients and 256 steps. Notes and metadata remain visible; advanced recipe references are text.
recipe.example:
Rinse @rice{1%cup}.

Add @water{2%cup} to a #pot{} and simmer for ~{20%minutes}.
recipe.failed: This recipe could not be opened. Check its text in Files, or refresh to try again. Recipes must be UTF-8 text up to 64 KB, with at most 128 ingredients and 256 steps.
recipe.saveFailed: The recipe could not be saved. Check its name, text and size, then unlock Local Admin and try again. Your original is unchanged.
recipe.changed: This recipe changed elsewhere. Cancel, refresh and open it again before editing.
workshop.help: Preview your STL, OBJ and 3MF models offline. Geometry is shown without linked material or texture files. Up to 16 MB and 100,000 triangles; 3MF core meshes and components are supported.
workshop.empty: No models yet. Import a model in Files, then open it here.
workshop.controls: Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. You can also use the buttons or focus the model and use the arrow, +, − and Home keys.
workshop.busy: Another model is still opening. Wait a moment, then refresh.
workshop.unsupported: This model is damaged, too large or uses geometry this preview cannot display. Try a smaller STL, OBJ or core 3MF model. Your original is kept in Files.
workshop.failed: The model could not be opened. Check that its file is still available, then refresh to try again.
workshop.graphicsFailed: This device could not draw the model. Reopen the model to retry. You can still save its original from File details.
room.help: Chat with people paired to this host. Messages are visible to joined participants. Only the latest 100 messages stay in memory; stopping sharing clears them. A disconnected page leaves after about 30 seconds.
room.chatOnly: Untick everything to share chat only. Paired devices can join LAN chat.
room.off: Sharing is off. Start sharing in Settings, then invite people with its pairing link.
room.disconnected: This sharing session is unavailable. Ask the host for its current pairing link.
room.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to the people who joined.
room.characters: {count} / 1,000 characters · Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
room.error.room_unavailable: Connection lost or sharing stopped. Sending was not confirmed; check recent messages before trying again. If you left, your presence will expire shortly.
room.error.room_rate: Messages are arriving too quickly. Wait a moment, then try again.
room.error.room_full: The chat is full or this device has too many open chat pages. Close an older page or wait a moment.
room.error.room_changed: Sharing restarted. Join the new chat before sending.
room.error.room_invalid: Use a message of up to 1,000 characters without unsupported control characters.
room.error.room_join_first: Join the chat before sending a message.
tv.title: TV mode
tv.help: Play selected photos, music and videos in a TV or player that supports local-network media (UPnP/DLNA). Playback depends on the player’s supported formats.
tv.warning: Anyone on your local network can read the selected media while TV mode is on. Private Notes and settings stay private.
tv.error: TV mode could not be updated. Check your local network and choose supported photos, music or videos, then try again.
tv.connect: In your TV or player’s local-network media list, open Tonalli TV. Keep both devices on the same local network.
tv.empty: Add photos, music or videos in Files first.
tv.noNetwork: Connect to a local network, then try again.
tv.lifetime: Stops when you close Tonalli or the local network is lost. Use Stop when finished.
tv.snapshotHelp: This session keeps the chosen copies. Stop and restart TV mode to include later file changes.
remote.title: Use a nearby library
remote.help: Read content shared by another Tonalli device on your local network. Your own library stays on this device.
remote.verifyHelp: Compare this certificate with “Verify this device’s certificate” on the sharing device. Continue only if they match.
remote.verified: I checked that the certificates match
remote.failed: Could not connect. Check the invitation, pairing code and local network, or return to your own library.
remote.connected: Reading a library shared by another device.
remote.shareHelp: Copy this invitation into Settings → Use a nearby library on the other device. Compare the certificates and enter the pairing code separately.
chat.grounded: Answers use only retrieved passages from the selected book. Check the numbered sources; citations do not guarantee that a claim is supported.
chat.prepareBook: Open this book and prepare article search
chat.prepareFirst: Prepare article search for this book in Library before asking.
chat.noSources: No matching passages were found. Try different words or another prepared book.
chat.unsupported: This answer has missing or invalid citations. Check it against the book.
chat.booksUnavailable: The book list is unavailable. Reopen this screen to retry.
chat.questionTooLong: Use a shorter question for this book.
models.title: Local AI
models.help: AI is off when you open the app. Models run only on this device. Loading verifies the file and checks available memory; your library stays usable if loading is refused.
models.state.stopping: Turning AI off… Waiting for the load to finish cleaning up.
models.installed: Already on this device. The file will be verified before loading.
models.downloadFirst: Download this model in Get content first.
models.unavailable: Model status is unavailable. Refresh to retry.
models.commandFailed: The model request could not be confirmed. Refresh to check its actual state.
models.error.model_missing: The model is missing. Download it in Get content.
models.error.model_refused: The model could not be loaded. Its format, storage or available memory is unsupported. On a phone with little memory, try the smallest model.
models.error.model_failed: The model could not be loaded. Your library is still available.
models.versionUnavailable: Local AI is unavailable in this version of the app.
chat.contextFull: This conversation is too long. Start a new conversation or use a shorter question.
chat.historyPrivacy: Conversations are saved on this device, outside Notes. They are not encrypted and are never included in nearby sharing.
chat.historyFailed: Saved conversations could not be read or changed. Your visible messages are still here.
chat.historyChanged: This conversation changed elsewhere. Open the saved conversation again before changing it.
chat.historyFull: Conversation storage is full. Delete an old conversation or start a shorter one.
chat.historySaveFailed: These latest messages could not be saved. Keep this page open and retry.
chat.loadSavedModel: To continue this conversation, load {model} in Settings.
